test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a competitive exam, 3 marks are to be awarded for every correct answer and for every wrong answer, 1 mark will be deducted. Sindhu scored 80 marks in this exam. Had 4 marks been awarded for each correct answer and 2 marks deducted for each incorrect answer, Sindhu would have scored 90 marks. If Sindhu attempted all the questions, then the number of questions in the test are:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the number of correct questions be x.

And the number of incorrect questions be y.

According to question,

⇒ 3x -1y = 80 ………………..(i)

⇒ 4x - 2y = 90 ………………..(ii)

Multiply by 2 in eq(i) 

⇒ 6x - 2y =160 …………………(iii)

Now, subtract eq(ii) from eq(iii),

⇒ 2x = 70

⇒ x = 35

Now, put the value of x in eq(i)

⇒ 105 -1y = 80

⇒ y = 25

⇒ x + y = 35 + 25 = 60

**∴ The number of questions in the test are 60.**
